{{Quote|Just what business is it you've come to Circumtore to discuss?''"<br />"''I think you've got a pretty good idea of that.''"<br />"''It wouldn't be something to do with a certain Oph Nar Dinnid, would it?|Gheeta and Boba Fett|<ref name="Armor" />}}
'''Circumtore''' was a ring-shaped artificial [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Circumtore system/Legends|same name]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Discovered by the main [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic community]] by the [[Rianitus Period]], Circumtore fell within the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] into the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Colonized by the [[Shell Hutts]] at some period, the [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] was visited by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] under the lead of [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in 1 ABY after they tracked the [[Lyunesi]] [[Oph Nar Dinnid]] and his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] there. However, the Shell Hutt [[Gheeta]] took out his grudge against Fett by [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dinnid and sending [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to [[Battle of Circumtore|engage]] the bounty hunters, though the latter group prevailed. Between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Circumtore was [[Attack on the Circumtore system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders and seized.

==Description==
Circumtore was an artificial, ring-shaped [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]]<ref name="Armor" /> situated in the [[Circumtore system/Legends|Circumtore system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. The [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]] was at the crossroads of the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]], [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]], and [[Kaaga Run/Legends|Kaaga Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], while being near the planets [[Rorak 4]], [[Affavan]], [[Carnovia]], and [[Ganath/Legends|Ganath]]. Circumtore was rather close to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Shell Hutts]] and some [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] could breathe freely in its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Armor" />

==History==
{{Quote|You realize, of course, that the party under discussion&mdash;this Dinnid person&mdash;is a guest on Circumtore.|Gheeta|<ref name="Armor" />}}
[[File:Showdown_at_Circumtore.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The skirmish on Circumtore]]
At some period in [[Time/Legends|time]], Circumtore's neighboring [[Orbit/Legends|orbitals]] in its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] were rendered charred and lifeless by a [[Disaster in the Circumtore system|disaster]]. The [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] discovered Circumtore and its system between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], in the [[Kymoodon Era]], and [[8000 BBY]], in the [[Rianitus Period]]. By [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], Circumtore fell in the space controlled by the Hutt species. It remained under Hutt control through the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and though it did fall in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] territory during the [[New Sith Wars]] between [[1004 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Circumtore was still under Hutt influence.<ref name="TEA" /> By 1 ABY,<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the events on Circumtore depicted in ''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]'' to four years prior to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], meaning they took place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was ruling the galaxy, a group of Hutts known as the Shell Hutts had colonized Circumtore.<ref name="Armor" />

Prior to 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> the Shell Hutt [[Gheeta]], who was in charge of building a [[Circumtore terminal and diplomatic reception area|terminal and diplomatic reception area]] on Circumtore, hired the freelance [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Emd Grahvess]] to construct it for him. Although Gheeta planned to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the architect when he was done in order to keep the man from producing any other great works, Grahvess escaped by putting a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his own head, which the infamous [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] collected. That enraged Gheeta, and as a result the Shell Hutts raised security measures around the planetoid to prevent it from happening again.<ref name="Armor" />

In 1 ABY,<ref name="Warfare" /> Fett returned to Circumtore with a group of hunters from the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]: [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], one of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droids]], and [[D'harhan]]. Tracking [[Oph Nar Dinnid]], a [[Lyunesi]] with a bounty on his head who had taken refuge on Circumtore, the bounty hunters were forced to go the planetoid's surface unarmed because of the security measures. Despite that, the group succeeded in fighting off a gang of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] with whom Ghetta tried to kill Fett in revenge before eliminating the Shell Hutt. However, D'harhan fell in the [[Battle of Circumtore|fighting]], and it turned out that Gheeta had actually killed Dinnid earlier.<ref name="Armor" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the area of space surrounding Circumtore boasted a population of 100 million to 500 million. Between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders took much of Hutt Space, and Circumtore itself was [[Attack on the Circumtore system|captured]] after Nal Hutta [[Battle of Nal Hutta|fell]]. Circumtore and its system were under Yuuzhan Vong rule by 27 ABY.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Shell Hutts}}
One of the main groups of beings living on Circumtore were the Shell Hutts, a relative of the Hutts. Considered just as greedy as their brethren, the Shell Hutts were also involved in the criminal underworld. They wore [[Armor/Legends|suits]] of metal with interior [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]], allowing them to float around off the ground. Circumtore was also home to the mercenaries whom the Shell Hutts hired in the Boba Fett incident prior to 1 ABY.<ref name="Armor" />

==Locations==
A terminal and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] reception area was present on Circumtore by 1 BBY, after Grahvess built it at the expense of Gheeta. The structure possessed great domes and spires, and had at least one [[Hangar/Legends|landing dock]].<ref name="Armor" />

==Behind the scenes==
Circumtore first appeared in the [[1998]] novel ''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]'', written by [[K. W. Jeter]] as the first entry in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Wars]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Armor" /> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], placed Circumtore in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" />
